questions.stem: For this instance, in total how many bijections are there from a collection with 6 objects onto itself?
questions.explanation: A bijection from a finite set to itself is a permutation of its elements, and there are 6 factorial such permutations, equal to 720. The required result is 720.
questions.hint: A bijection on a finite set is a permutation.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.learningObjective: Solve problems involving functions: injective, surjective, bijective.
questions.stem: For this instance, in total how many functions are there from a domain of 5 objects to a codomain of 6 objects?
questions.explanation: Each of the 5 domain elements can map independently to any of the 6 codomain elements, so there are 6 to the power 5, namely 7776, functions in total. The required result is 7776.
questions.hint: Each domain element has independent choices in the codomain.
